_doc: Shared by tests/test_routing_scoring.py (scoring.cell_ratio) and tests/js/directions.test.mjs (cellRatio in web/app.js): the same cell, measure and city averages must give the same ratio on the page and in the API. `hour` null is the all-hours view. `own` is the average of the measure on screen (hourly when hour is set); `overall` the all-hours average.

cases.name: all hours, nothing reported borrows its smoothed rate
hourly, nothing at that hour borrows all hours
hourly, no hourly row borrows all hours
